+"""Integer clamping utility."""
+
+
+def clamp_int(value: int, lower: int, upper: int) -> int:
+    """Clamp an integer value within the inclusive range [lower, upper].
+
+    Acceptance criteria:
+    - AC-1: when value < lower, return lower.
+    - AC-2: when value == lower, return lower.
+    - AC-3: when lower < value < upper, return value unchanged.
+    - AC-4: when value == upper, return upper.
+    - AC-5: when value > upper, return upper.
+    - AC-6: when lower > upper, raise ValueError.
+    - AC-7: deterministic with no I/O, network, persistence, clock, or external dependencies.
+    - AC-8: when lower == upper, return that bound for every integer value.
+    """
+    if lower > upper:
+        raise ValueError(f"lower bound ({lower}) cannot be greater than upper bound ({upper})")
+    if value < lower:
+        return lower
+    if value > upper:
+        return upper
+    return value

+from clamp import clamp_int

+class TestClampInt(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_ac1_value_less_than_lower(self):
+        """AC-1: when value < lower, return lower."""
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(0, 5, 10), 5)
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(-10, -5, 5), -5)
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(-100, 0, 100), 0)
+
+    def test_ac2_value_equals_lower(self):
+        """AC-2: when value == lower, return lower."""
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(5, 5, 10), 5)
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(-5, -5, 5), -5)
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(0, 0, 10), 0)
+
+    def test_ac3_value_between_lower_and_upper(self):
+        """AC-3: when lower < value < upper, return value unchanged."""
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(6, 5, 10), 6)
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(0, -5, 5), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(clamp_int(42, 10, 100), 42)

+    def test_ac4_value_equals_upper(self):

+    def test_ac5_value_greater_than_upper(self):
